purpose: Owner-reviewed zero-spend automation approvals for exact public investigation source URLs. Entries do not approve linked domains, changed URLs, authenticated services, paid tiers or non-public data.

doj-epstein-disclosures.licence: Public DOJ material; seals, logos and third-party material remain subject to DOJ legal policies. One bounded page request per scheduled collection.

doj-justice-news.licence: Public DOJ news material; seals, logos and third-party material remain subject to DOJ legal policies. One bounded page request per scheduled collection.

doj-oig-reports.licence: Public DOJ OIG report index; underlying reports retain their stated legal and attribution notices. One bounded page request per scheduled collection.

sec-current-filings.licence: Free public EDGAR access under SEC fair-access rules. Requests identify the Matrix Reprogrammed user agent and remain far below the SEC request-rate ceiling.

sec-litigation-releases.licence: Free public SEC enforcement index under SEC fair-access rules. One bounded page request per scheduled collection.

usaspending-recent-contracts.licence: Free public federal spending API. Requests are operator-capped, unauthenticated and limited to public award fields.

treasury-ofac-recent-actions.licence: Public Treasury/OFAC recent-actions index; no authenticated or licensing-system access. One bounded page request per scheduled collection.

house-oversight-releases.licence: Public House committee release index. House seals, recordings and third-party material retain applicable restrictions. One bounded page request per scheduled collection.

uk-sfo-news.licence: GOV.UK public content is used lawfully under its terms; Crown copyright and Open Government Licence conditions apply where stated. One bounded page request per scheduled collection.

eppo-news.licence: Public EPPO news index; EPPO copyright, disclaimer and data-protection notices remain applicable. One bounded page request per scheduled collection.

quarantine.wikileaks-publications: Not auto-approved: current terms, privacy, operational reliability and automation permissions are not sufficiently verified for fail-closed production use.
